summary: This video showcases a high-performing Vortex II composition from Chinese Season 9 servers utilizing Celestine and Sia alongside support banner heroes. Even at hero level 79 at the start of Vortex II without vault items, the setup achieves close to 5 billion damage. The video breaks down the full gear, artifact selection, set bonuses, and exact skill auto-timing parameters for both teams. Key build advice includes placing Puppeteer sets on heroes like Diantha, Celestine, and Twitch, while equipping Sia with Rift Hourglass.
